sentences.en: The promise and the peril of the Green New Deal.

sentences.en: The day that Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, who has, of course, skyrocketed in celebrity,
sentences.zh: 那天，亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯众议员——当然，她的人气已经飙升，
zh_words: 亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥

sentences.en: essentially, to become this iconic figure on the left, introduced, it's called a non-binding resolution.
sentences.zh: 本质上成为了左翼的标志性人物——提出了一项所谓的“不具约束力的决议”。

sentences.en: Beautiful.

sentences.en: Thank you.

sentences.en: And thank you to all of my colleagues here that have joined us today.
sentences.zh: 也感谢今天加入我们的所有同事。

sentences.en: This is so incredible.
sentences.zh: 这真是太不可思议了。

sentences.en: Where she sort of came forward at this press conference on Capitol Hill, this freezing cold day, she wore a green suit.
sentences.zh: 她在国会山举行的新闻发布会上露面，那天天气奇冷，她穿着一身绿色的套装。

sentences.en: And I am so incredibly excited that we are going to transition this country into the future and we are not going to be dragged behind by our paSt.
sentences.zh: 我非常激动，我们将带领这个国家走向未来，而不会被我们的过去所拖累。

sentences.en: And laid out this set of sweeping, incredibly ambitious proposals about how to both tackle climate change and solve social injustice all in one package.
sentences.zh: 她提出了一系列全面且雄心勃勃的提案，旨在将应对气候变化与解决社会不公结合在一个方案中。

sentences.en: So how do Democrats react to this proposal from their new star freshman House colleague?
sentences.zh: 那么，民主党人对他们这位新晋的众议院明星议员提出的提案有何反应？

sentences.en: I am supporting the Green New Deal.
sentences.zh: 我支持“绿色新政”。

sentences.en: So it was amazing to see a number of the presidential candidates immediately embraced it.
sentences.zh: 看到许多总统候选人立即表示支持，真是令人惊讶。

sentences.en: Does the Green New Deal go too far?
sentences.zh: “绿色新政”是否走得太远了？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Bernie Sanders.
sentences.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯。

sentences.en: You cannot go too far on the issue of climate change.
sentences.zh: 在气候变化问题上，你不可能走得太远。

sentences.en: The future of the planet is at stake.
sentences.zh: 地球的未来危在旦夕。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Warren, Kirsten Gillibrand.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦，克里斯汀·吉利布兰德。

sentences.en: I support all the framework that the Green New Deal supports because...
sentences.zh: 我支持“绿色新政”所支持的所有框架，因为……

sentences.en: Kamala Harris, Cory Booker.
sentences.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯，科里·布克。

sentences.en: Our planet is in peril and we need to be bold.
sentences.zh: 我们的星球处于危险之中，我们需要大胆行动。

sentences.en: It's one of the reasons why I signed on to the resolution, I co-sponsored the resolution for the Green New Deal.
sentences.zh: 这也是我签署该决议的原因之一，我共同发起了“绿色新政”决议。

sentences.en: They didn't just embrace it, they co-sponsored it.
sentences.zh: 他们不仅是支持，更是共同发起。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That is our history.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的历史。

sentences.en: You know, it became clear that they could see that Representative Ocasio-Cortez had become this celebrity, had become this star, had galvanized the progressive left.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很明显他们看出奥卡西奥-科尔特斯众议员已经成为了名人，成为了明星，并激励了进步左翼。

sentences.en: And there's a tremendous eagerness, particularly on the part of the presidential candidates, to just jump right into that and harness that.
sentences.zh: 而且人们有一种巨大的渴望，特别是总统候选人们，想要直接加入并利用这种势头。

sentences.en: They want to get that energy.
sentences.zh: 他们想要获得那种能量。

sentences.en: And this is one of the first big policy things that she did.
sentences.zh: 这是她所做的第一项重大政策举措之一。

sentences.en: And so, you know, she just saw all of the, the, not just the progressive left, but the establishment Democrats, the more moderate
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，她看到不仅是进步左翼，还有建制派民主党人，以及更温和的

sentences.en: Democrats, jumping on and saying, hey, this is mine too.
sentences.zh: 民主党人，都纷纷加入并说，嘿，这也是我的主张。

sentences.en: Well, so how much of that has to do with all these reports that say basically climate change is upon us, it's here, it's happening?
sentences.zh: 那么，这在多大程度上与那些基本上说气候变化已经来临、正在发生、就在眼前的报告有关？

sentences.en: It has a lot to do with it.
sentences.zh: 这有很大关系。

sentences.en: I think there are three key things that have contributed to the changing politics of climate change, Michael.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我认为有三个关键因素促成了气候变化政治的转变。

sentences.en: One, as you said, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 第一，正如你所说，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Just in the past year or two alone, there have been major new reports that say clearly and definitively
sentences.zh: 仅在过去一两年里，就有重大的新报告明确且肯定地指出，

sentences.en: a lot of the extreme weather events that we are seeing now are caused by climate change.
sentences.zh: 我们现在看到的许多极端天气事件都是由气候变化引起的。

sentences.en: Second thing is polling shows that millennials who will soon be the largest voting demographic, that this is an issue they care about more than almost anything else.
sentences.zh: 第二点是民调显示，即将成为最大投票群体的千禧一代，对这个问题的关心程度几乎超过了其他任何事情。

sentences.en: That's a big change.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的变化。

sentences.en: The third thing I think that politicians are paying attention to is President Trump.
sentences.zh: 我认为政客们关注的第三点是特朗普总统。

sentences.en: President Trump has made climate change an issue because he has elevated climate policy.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统让气候变化成为了一个议题，因为他提升了气候政策的地位。

sentences.en: He has said he's going to withdraw the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他说他要让美国

sentences.en: from the Paris Climate Agreement.
sentences.zh: 退出《巴黎气候协定》。

sentences.en: He's rolling back climate change regulations.
sentences.zh: 他正在撤销气候变化法规。

sentences.en: He mocks climate science.
sentences.zh: 他嘲笑气候科学。

sentences.en: So that, all of those kind of present a clear way for his prospective opponents to carve out a strong position against him.
sentences.zh: 所以，所有这些都为他的潜在对手提供了一个明确的方式，来确立反对他的强硬立场。

sentences.en: So it appeared the moment was uniquely right for something like this to come along.
sentences.zh: 看来时机非常适合这样的事情出现。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The Green New Deal, a six-page resolution on issues related to America's role in global climate change.
sentences.zh: “绿色新政”是一份六页的决议，涉及美国在全球气候变化中的角色等问题。

sentences.en: Okay, so what is actually in the Green New Deal?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么“绿色新政”里到底有什么？

sentences.en: So the Green New Deal is very broad, but in terms of climate change, it says...
sentences.zh: “绿色新政”非常广泛，但就气候变化而言，它说……

sentences.en: The Green New Deal calls for reducing carbon emissions to zero and moving the U.S.
sentences.zh: “绿色新政”呼吁将碳排放量降至零，并让美国

sentences.en: off of fossil fuels in 10 years.
sentences.zh: 在10年内摆脱化石燃料。

sentences.en: The entire world needs to get to zero emissions by 2050.
sentences.zh: 全世界需要在2050年之前实现零排放。

sentences.en: It would meet 100 percent of the power demand through clean and renewable energy sources.
sentences.zh: 它将通过清洁和可再生能源满足100%的电力需求。

sentences.en: A 10-year plan to slash CO2 emissions in the United States to get to getting 100 percent of U.S.
sentences.zh: 一个10年计划，旨在削减美国的二氧化碳排放量，实现100%的美国

sentences.en: electricity from clean and renewable sources such as wind and solar.
sentences.zh: 电力来自风能和太阳能等清洁和可再生能源。

sentences.en: Eliminating gas-powered engines like cars, making air travel obsolete, retrofitting all existing buildings.
sentences.zh: 淘汰燃气发动机（如汽车），使航空旅行过时，改造所有现有建筑。

sentences.en: So those are kind of the broad strokes of what it says about climate change.
sentences.zh: 所以这些就是它关于气候变化的大致内容。

sentences.en: And all of them are wildly ambitious.
sentences.zh: 而且所有这些都极其雄心勃勃。

sentences.en: Those are extremely ambitious just in terms of energy and climate policy.
sentences.zh: 仅就能源和气候政策而言，这些目标都非常宏大。

sentences.en: But it also goes way, way, way beyond that.
sentences.zh: 但它还远远不止于此。

sentences.en: It talks about how, you know, working to achieve these goals could create new green jobs.
sentences.zh: 它谈到，你知道，努力实现这些目标可以创造新的绿色就业机会。

sentences.en: But it also talks about guaranteeing health care, guaranteed minimum wage, family and medical leave, paid vacations, and retirement security to every American.
sentences.zh: 但它也谈到了为每一位美国人提供医疗保障、最低工资保障、家庭和医疗假、带薪休假以及退休保障。

sentences.en: So it's kind of a kitchen sink of liberal aspirations.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是一个自由派愿望的“大杂烩”。

sentences.en: It's a little bit of everything.
sentences.zh: 什么都有一点。

sentences.en: It is a social, progressive, liberal wish list, all kind of bundled in to this thing that's supposed to be about climate change with no clear policy prescriptions on how actually
sentences.zh: 这是一个社会、进步、自由派的愿望清单，全部打包进这个本应是关于气候变化的东西里，却没有明确的政策方案来说明如何实际

sentences.en: to achieve any of these goals.
sentences.zh: 实现这些目标。

sentences.en: And just to be clear, this sounds a little inside baseball, but it's important to note, this whole sweeping proposal is also not even a bill.
sentences.zh: 还要明确一点，这听起来可能有点内行话，但必须指出，整个宏大的提案甚至不是一项法案。

sentences.en: What is it?
sentences.zh: 那它是什么？

sentences.en: It is a non-binding resolution, which is about the weakest thing that you can bring up in Congress.
sentences.zh: 它是一项不具约束力的决议，这是你在国会能提出的最无力的东西。

sentences.en: It is a statement of what you want, of what you would like to have.
sentences.zh: 它只是表达了你想要什么，你希望拥有什么。

sentences.en: So if it were to ever pass, it would do nothing.
sentences.zh: 所以即使它通过了，也不会有任何实际作用。

sentences.en: It would be Congress saying...
sentences.zh: 这相当于国会在说……

sentences.en: This is what we wish for.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的愿望。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So it's a kind of manifesto more than anything.
sentences.zh: 所以它更像是一份宣言。

sentences.en: That's a good way of putting it.
sentences.zh: 这样说很贴切。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It seems that it's really just about trying to get the party to come together with one voice and say, we care about this.
sentences.zh: 看来这真的只是为了让党派团结一致，发出同一个声音说，我们关心这个问题。

sentences.en: These are the goals that we have as a party, which, you know, for this particular party, which has often been fractured and divided, is not necessarily a small thing.
sentences.zh: 这些是我们作为一个政党的目标，你知道，对于这个经常分裂的政党来说，这并非小事。

sentences.en: So what happens next?
sentences.zh: 那么接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: So soon after this resolution gets introduced, things start falling apart.
sentences.zh: 在该决议提出后不久，事情就开始出岔子了。

sentences.en: The first thing that happened was there was a huge just logistical screw-up.
sentences.zh: 首先发生的是一个巨大的后勤失误。

sentences.en: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez's office had sent out this sheet of talking points about what was in the package.
sentences.zh: 亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯的办公室发出了一份关于方案内容的谈话要点清单。
zh_words: 亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥

sentences.en: Unfortunately, some of the things that were in the talking points actually weren't in the package, including, for example, a guaranteed right to work for those unable or unwilling
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，谈话要点中的一些内容实际上并不在方案中，例如，为那些无法或不愿

sentences.en: to work.
sentences.zh: 工作的人提供工作保障的权利。

sentences.en: And within days, you had Republicans saying, this is the best thing that's ever happened.
sentences.zh: 几天之内，共和党人就说，这是有史以来最好的事情。

sentences.en: This is rife with targets for us.
sentences.zh: 这对我们来说简直是靶子。

sentences.en: The only thing green about the so-called Green New Deal is how much green it's going to cost taxpayers if these people ever pass it into law.
sentences.zh: 所谓的“绿色新政”唯一绿色的地方，就是如果这些人真的通过了法律，它将花费纳税人多少钱。

sentences.en: You know, it was Yes, We Can, but I'm wondering if now it's Yes, We Can become a socialist country.
sentences.zh: 你知道，以前是“是的，我们能”，但我现在怀疑是否变成了“是的，我们能成为一个社会主义国家”。

sentences.en: And I know that...
sentences.zh: 我知道……

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: This is actually not about green energy.
sentences.zh: 这其实与绿色能源无关。

sentences.en: This is really about socialism.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是关于社会主义。

sentences.en: This is nothing more than a socialist Trojan horse.
sentences.zh: 这不过是社会主义的特洛伊木马。

sentences.en: That's why they've inserted...
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他们插入了……

sentences.en: Because the impression that's left is that Democratic presidential candidates have signed on to something that seems to support paying people who are unwilling to work, which
sentences.zh: 因为留下的印象是，民主党总统候选人签署了一份似乎支持向不愿工作的人支付报酬的文件，这

sentences.en: feels like essentially catnip to Fox News, to anyone in the conservative Republican world.
sentences.zh: 对福克斯新闻和保守派共和党世界里的任何人来说，简直是致命诱惑。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And Democrats are put on the defense of saying, no, no, no, I supported the bill, but I don't support this other thing that's a description of the bill.
sentences.zh: 民主党人被迫处于防守地位，说，不，不，不，我支持该法案，但我不支持那个对法案的描述。

sentences.en: That's a terrible position for them to be in.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说是一个糟糕的处境。

sentences.en: And of course, kind of immediately, it created a backlash, not so much to climate change, but to this particular proposal.
sentences.zh: 当然，它几乎立即引发了反弹，不是针对气候变化本身，而是针对这个特定的提案。

sentences.en: I meant it, but they should stay with that argument, never change.
sentences.zh: 我是认真的，但他们应该坚持那个论点，永远不要改变。

sentences.en: Never change.
sentences.zh: 永远不要改变。

sentences.en: No planes.
sentences.zh: 没有飞机。

sentences.en: No energy.
sentences.zh: 没有能源。

sentences.en: When the wind stops blowing, that's the end of your electric.
sentences.zh: 当风停了，你的电力也就完了。

sentences.en: Let's hurry up.
sentences.zh: 快点。

sentences.en: Darling?
sentences.zh: 亲爱的？

sentences.en: Darling, is the wind blowing today?
sentences.zh: 亲爱的，今天有风吗？

sentences.en: I'd like to watch television, darling.
sentences.zh: 我想看电视，亲爱的。

sentences.en: And what happens with moderate Democrats?
sentences.zh: 那么温和派民主党人发生了什么？

sentences.en: How are they responding to this proposal?
sentences.zh: 他们对这个提案有何反应？

sentences.en: So some of them kind of started backtracking and saying, well, well, we will also be, you know, unveiling our own climate proposals in the campaigns.
sentences.zh: 所以他们中的一些人开始退缩，说，嗯，嗯，我们也会在竞选中公布我们自己的气候提案。

sentences.en: So it will be different from this.
sentences.zh: 所以它会和这个不同。

sentences.en: So I think a lot of Democrats are saying, wait a minute, let's find our own proposal that maybe is not quite this thing.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为很多民主党人在说，等一下，让我们找到我们自己的提案，也许不完全是这个东西。

sentences.en: And then it blew up even more when...
sentences.zh: 然后当……的时候，它爆发得更厉害了。

sentences.en: What are we doing here?
sentences.zh: 我们在这里做什么？

sentences.en: We're standing up asking for the new Green Deal.
sentences.zh: 我们站在这里要求新的“绿色新政”。

sentences.en: We're trying to present this letter that we've made to Senator Feinstein.
sentences.zh: 我们正试图把我们写的这封信交给范斯坦参议员。

sentences.en: We saw these supporters of the Green New Deal confronted Senator Dianne Feinstein, the Democrat of California, one of the older members of the Senate,
sentences.zh: 我们看到“绿色新政”的支持者与加利福尼亚州民主党参议员黛安·范斯坦对峙，她是参议院最年长的成员之一，

sentences.en: very much kind of an establishment figure, someone who's always been considered a reliable yes vote on environmental issues.
sentences.zh: 非常典型的建制派人物，一直被认为是环境问题上可靠的赞成票。

sentences.zh: 是时候抛开党派偏见，承认我们面临着人类造成的重大危机，并且我们有迫切而明显的需要去解决它。

sentences.en: And when I think of Schumer, I think of the embodiment of the party's kind of myth, a figure who is not a far left figure.
sentences.zh: 当我想到舒默时，我想到的是该党某种神话的化身，一个并非极左的人物。

sentences.en: And so I wonder what it signals that he's the one out there embracing this as the future of the party.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，由他出面拥抱这个作为党的未来，意味着什么。

sentences.en: That is the thing that I thought was the craziest of all.
sentences.zh: 那是我认为最疯狂的事情。

sentences.en: He has never elevated this.
sentences.zh: 他从未提升过这个议题。

sentences.en: He's never talked about it.
sentences.zh: 他从未谈论过它。

sentences.en: He's never pushed on it because it's never been seen as a vote getter.
sentences.zh: 他从未推动过它，因为它从未被视为能拉票的议题。

sentences.en: So to all of a sudden see Chuck Schumer go out on the floor and talk like he's like a climate evangelist is amazing.
sentences.zh: 所以突然看到查克·舒默走上议事厅，谈吐得像个气候福音传道者，真是令人惊讶。

sentences.en: To be fair to Schumer, he said he's a new grandfather, too, so he cares about his grandchild.
sentences.zh: 公平地说，舒默说他也是个新爷爷，所以他关心他的孙辈。

sentences.en: But I do think he is also, you know, looking at these polls and looking at this Feinstein video that went viral and freaking out a little bit and thinking, well,
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为他也是，你知道，在看这些民调，看着那段在网上疯传的范斯坦视频，然后有点惊慌失措，心想，好吧，

sentences.en: we got to strategize for the next elections.
sentences.zh: 我们必须为下次选举制定策略。

sentences.en: So, Coral, what do we make of this?
sentences.zh: 那么，科拉尔，我们该如何看待这件事？

sentences.en: First, the Green New Deal is the hot new thing.
sentences.zh: 首先，“绿色新政”是当下最热门的话题。

sentences.en: Then it is the hot potato.
sentences.zh: 接着，它又成了烫手山芋。

sentences.en: But somehow it landed with Schumer standing on the Senate floor talking about climate change in this new, powerful way for him.
sentences.zh: 但不知何故，舒默站在参议院大厅里，以一种对他而言全新的、有力的方式谈论气候变化，这让它产生了影响。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So at the end of the day, I'm very skeptical that the actual Green New Deal is going to be passed or put into effect.
sentences.zh: 所以归根结底，我非常怀疑真正的“绿色新政”是否会被通过或付诸实施。

sentences.en: But the sudden skyrocketing to fame of the Green New Deal and Representative Ocasio-Cortez and the rallying of the millennials and even the pushback, even the fallout.
sentences.zh: 但“绿色新政”和奥卡西奥-科尔特斯众议员的突然走红，以及千禧一代的集结，甚至是随之而来的反弹和后果。

sentences.en: It showed the Democratic Party leaders, even the sort of middle of the road political pragmatists,
sentences.zh: 这向民主党领导人，甚至是那些中间派的政治务实主义者表明，

sentences.en: that there is a new energy and interest from a key demographic of voter that they care about.
sentences.zh: 他们所关心的关键选民群体中，出现了一种新的活力和关注点。

sentences.en: That was the effect of this whole Green New Deal roller coaster.
sentences.zh: 这就是整个“绿色新政”过山车般起伏所带来的影响。

sentences.en: And the outcome is we're in new territory.
sentences.zh: 结果就是我们进入了一个新的领域。

sentences.en: I never thought I would write the sentence that Chuck Schumer wants to elevate the issue of climate change for campaigns, ever.
sentences.zh: 我从未想过我会写下这样一句话：查克·舒默竟然想要在竞选中提升气候变化议题的地位，这真是破天荒。

sentences.en: So actually, you could argue that this resolution that seemed like a kind of political fiasco in the beginning, it actually kind of worked.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，你可以说这项起初看起来像是一场政治闹剧的决议，其实还挺管用的。

sentences.en: It injected this issue into the Democratic Party's bloodstream just as people like Ocasio-Cortez and liberals perhaps intended.
sentences.zh: 它正如奥卡西奥-科尔特斯之流以及自由派人士所预期的那样，将这一议题注入了民主党的血液中。

sentences.en: Even if nothing that the Green New Deal calls for actually comes to pass, it has changed the conversation, it has changed the political calculus,
sentences.zh: 即使“绿色新政”所呼吁的一切最终都未能实现，它也已经改变了对话，改变了政治算计，

sentences.en: and it has helped bring the issue of climate change into the top tier of political campaigns, a place it's never been.
sentences.zh: 并且它帮助将气候变化议题提升到了政治竞选的最高层面，这是以前从未有过的。

sentences.en: Coral, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 科拉尔，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Thanks to our powerful trade policies, the trade deficit is falling and falling and falling.
sentences.zh: 多亏了我们强有力的贸易政策，贸易逆差正在不断下降。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, the Trump administration said that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周三，特朗普政府表示，美国

sentences.en: trade deficit has surged to the highest level in history, despite two years of America first trade policies aimed at reducing it.
sentences.zh: 贸易逆差已飙升至历史最高水平，尽管两年来一直在推行旨在减少逆差的“美国优先”贸易政策。

sentences.en: The days of plundering American jobs and American wealth, those days are over.
sentences.zh: 掠夺美国就业机会和美国财富的日子，那些日子已经结束了。

sentences.en: They're over.
sentences.zh: 它们结束了。

sentences.en: America firSt.
sentences.zh: 美国优先。

sentences.en: America firSt.
sentences.zh: 美国优先。

sentences.en: In 2018, the gap between what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 2018年，美国进出口之间的差距

sentences.en: imported and exported reached $891 billion, largely driven by rising imports from China, a frequent target of the president's punitive trade policies.
sentences.zh: 达到了8910亿美元，这在很大程度上是由从中国进口的增加所驱动的，而中国正是总统惩罚性贸易政策的频繁目标。

sentences.en: We can't continue to allow China to rape our country, and that's what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 我们不能继续允许中国强奸我们的国家，而这正是他们正在做的事情。

sentences.en: It's the greatest theft in the history of the world.
sentences.zh: 这是世界历史上最大的盗窃案。

sentences.en: Economists are generally unbothered by trade deficits, saying they pose little risk to the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 经济学家通常对贸易逆差并不感到困扰，称其对美国构成的风险很小，

sentences.en: but President Trump has described them as a major threat and has made eliminating them the biggest priority of his economic agenda.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普总统将其描述为重大威胁，并已将消除逆差作为其经济议程的首要任务。

sentences.en: And in a major announcement on Wednesday, the founder of Facebook, Mark Zuckerberg, outlined a plan to change the nature of social media from public to private communications.
sentences.zh: 在周三的一项重大公告中，Facebook创始人马克·扎克伯格概述了一项计划，旨在将社交媒体的性质从公共交流转变为私人交流。

sentences.en: Instead of encouraging users to post material for all to see,
sentences.zh: 扎克伯格表示，Facebook等网站将不再鼓励用户发布供所有人查看的内容，

sentences.en: Zuckerberg said that sites like Facebook would now focus on more direct and encrypted communications in which users message smaller groups of people that they know.
sentences.zh: 而是专注于更直接、加密的通信，让用户与他们认识的小群体进行交流。

sentences.en: The change is designed in part to address growing concerns from Facebook users about the privacy of their personal data.
sentences.zh: 这一改变的部分目的是为了解决Facebook用户对个人数据隐私日益增长的担忧。

sentences.en: Unlike publicly shared posts, which are kept in users' permanent records, these more private communications can be deleted after a certain period of time.
sentences.zh: 与保存在用户永久记录中的公开分享帖子不同，这些更私密的通信可以在一段时间后被删除。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。
